verdict.rationale: Riveter's enrichment model processes many rows per run (bulk scraping/searching across rows) and includes SDK-level retries, polling, and pagination that support running large jobs reliably, but there is no explicit documentation of concurrency limits, parallel session counts, or throughput guarantees for running many simultaneous scraping sessions. missing for 10: explicit concurrency/session limits, scaling architecture details, benchmarks on parallel throughput.
